t: 巴达维亚共和国在荷兰宣告成立，取代了荷兰共和国。
te: The Batavian Republic is proclaimed in the Netherlands, replacing the Dutch Republic.
dz: 巴达维亚共和国在荷兰宣告成立，取代了荷兰共和国。
de: The Batavian Republic is proclaimed in the Netherlands, replacing the Dutch Republic.

t: 在穿越被冰冻的祖伊德泽后,法国骑兵俘虏了14艘荷兰舰只和850门火炮,罕见地发生了海军舰只向陆…
te: After crossing the frozen Zuiderzee, the French cavalry capture 14 Dutch ships and 850 guns, in a rare occurrence of su…
dz: 在穿越被冰冻的祖伊德泽后,法国骑兵俘虏了14艘荷兰舰只和850门火炮,罕见地发生了海军舰只向陆战队投降.
de: After crossing the frozen Zuiderzee, the French cavalry capture 14 Dutch ships and 850 guns, in a rare occurrence of surrender of naval vessels to land forces.
p: Capture of the Dutch fleet at Den Helder

t: 美国宪法第11修正案被批准.
te: The 11th Amendment to the United States Constitution is ratified.
dz: 美国宪法第11修正案被批准.
de: The 11th Amendment to the United States Constitution is ratified.

t: 在格林纳达爆发了Fédon叛乱,叛军夺取了Grenville,后来又夺取了Gouyave.
te: The Fédon Rebellion breaks out in Grenada, the rebels seizing Grenville and later Gouyave.
dz: 在格林纳达爆发了Fédon叛乱,叛军夺取了Grenville,后来又夺取了Gouyave.
de: The Fédon Rebellion breaks out in Grenada, the rebels seizing Grenville and later Gouyave.

t: 哈尔达战役由马拉塔邦联与海得拉巴的尼扎姆交战,结果马拉塔获胜.
te: The Battle of Kharda is fought between the Maratha Confederacy and the Nizam of Hyderabad, resulting in Maratha victory.
dz: 哈尔达战役由马拉塔邦联与海得拉巴的尼扎姆交战,结果马拉塔获胜.
de: The Battle of Kharda is fought between the Maratha Confederacy and the Nizam of Hyderabad, resulting in Maratha victory.

t: 波兰-立陶宛联邦北部的克兰和塞米加利亚公国已不复存在并成为帝国俄罗斯的一部分.
te: The Duchy of Courland and Semigallia, a northern fief of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, ceases to exist and become…
dz: 波兰分治:波兰-立陶宛联邦北部的克兰和塞米加利亚公国已不复存在并成为帝国俄罗斯的一部分.
de: Partitions of Poland: The Duchy of Courland and Semigallia, a northern fief of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, ceases to exist and becomes part of Imperial Russia.

t: 法国和普鲁士之间实现了巴塞尔和平.
te: Peace of Basel between France and Prussia is made.
dz: 法国和普鲁士之间实现了巴塞尔和平.
de: Peace of Basel between France and Prussia is made.

t: 法兰西第一共和国采用公斤和克作为主要质量单位.
te: The French First Republic adopts the kilogram and gram as its primary unit of mass.
dz: 法兰西第一共和国采用公斤和克作为主要质量单位.
de: The French First Republic adopts the kilogram and gram as its primary unit of mass.

t: 法国大革命：革命法庭被镇压。
te: The Revolutionary Tribunal is suppressed.
dz: 法国大革命：革命法庭被镇压。
de: French Revolution: The Revolutionary Tribunal is suppressed.

t: 在后来被称为康沃利斯撤退的事件中，威廉·康沃利斯中将率领的英国皇家海军中队强烈抵抗了规模大得多…
te: In what became known as Cornwallis's Retreat, a British Royal Navy squadron led by Vice Admiral William Cornwallis stro…
dz: 法国革命战争：在后来被称为康沃利斯撤退的事件中，威廉·康沃利斯中将率领的英国皇家海军中队强烈抵抗了规模大得多的法国海军部队，并基本完好无损地撤退，导致法国海军在六天后的格鲁瓦战役中惨败。
de: French Revolutionary Wars: In what became known as Cornwallis's Retreat, a British Royal Navy squadron led by Vice Admiral William Cornwallis strongly resists a much larger French Navy force and withdraws largely intact, setting up the French Navy defeat at the Battle of Groix six days later.

t: 斯韦伦达姆的堡垒驱逐了荷属东印度公司地方法官并宣布成立共和国.
te: The burghers of Swellendam expel the Dutch East India Company magistrate and declare a republic.
dz: 斯韦伦达姆的堡垒驱逐了荷属东印度公司地方法官并宣布成立共和国.
de: The burghers of Swellendam expel the Dutch East India Company magistrate and declare a republic.

t: Financier James Swan偿付了美国革命期间累积的2 024 899美元的国债.
te: Financier James Swan pays off the $2,024,899 US national debt that had been accrued during the American Revolution.
dz: Financier James Swan偿付了美国革命期间累积的2 024 899美元的国债.
de: Financier James Swan pays off the $2,024,899 US national debt that had been accrued during the American Revolution.

t: 格林维尔条约签署,结束了俄亥俄州的西北印第安人战争.
te: Treaty of Greenville is signed, ending the Northwest Indian War in the Ohio Country.
dz: 格林维尔条约签署,结束了俄亥俄州的西北印第安人战争.
de: Treaty of Greenville is signed, ending the Northwest Indian War in the Ohio Country.

t: 英国人从荷兰人手中夺取了亭可马里（今斯里兰卡），以防止其落入法国人手中。
te: The British capture Trincomalee (present-day Sri Lanka) from the Dutch in order to keep it out of French hands.
dz: 第一次反法同盟战争：英国人从荷兰人手中夺取了亭可马里（今斯里兰卡），以防止其落入法国人手中。
de: War of the First Coalition: The British capture Trincomalee (present-day Sri Lanka) from the Dutch in order to keep it out of French hands.

t: 英国夺取了南部非洲的荷兰开普殖民地,以阻止巴塔维亚共和国使用.
te: Britain seizes the Dutch Cape Colony in southern Africa to prevent its use by the Batavian Republic.
dz: 英国夺取了南部非洲的荷兰开普殖民地,以阻止巴塔维亚共和国使用.
de: Britain seizes the Dutch Cape Colony in southern Africa to prevent its use by the Batavian Republic.

t: 斯普里蒙战役后一年多,奥地利荷兰(今比利时)被法国革命者正式吞并.
te: More than a year after the Battle of Sprimont, the Austrian Netherlands (present-day Belgium) are officially annexed by…
dz: 斯普里蒙战役后一年多,奥地利荷兰(今比利时)被法国革命者正式吞并.
de: More than a year after the Battle of Sprimont, the Austrian Netherlands (present-day Belgium) are officially annexed by Revolutionary France.

t: 拿破仑首先通过镇压威胁国民大会的反革命暴乱分子而上升到显要地位.
te: Napoleon first rises to prominence by suppressing counter-revolutionary rioters threatening the National Convention.
dz: 拿破仑首先通过镇压威胁国民大会的反革命暴乱分子而上升到显要地位.
de: Napoleon first rises to prominence by suppressing counter-revolutionary rioters threatening the National Convention.

t: 波兰被俄罗斯,普鲁士和奥地利完全消耗.
te: Poland is completely consumed by Russia, Prussia and Austria.
dz: 波兰被俄罗斯,普鲁士和奥地利完全消耗.
de: Poland is completely consumed by Russia, Prussia and Austria.

t: 美国和西班牙签署"马德里条约",确定了西班牙殖民地与美国的边界.
te: The United States and Spain sign the Treaty of Madrid, which establishes the boundaries between Spanish colonies and th…
dz: 美国和西班牙签署"马德里条约",确定了西班牙殖民地与美国的边界.
de: The United States and Spain sign the Treaty of Madrid, which establishes the boundaries between Spanish colonies and the U.S.

t: 创建了由五人组成的革命政府"法国目录".
te: The French Directory, a five-man revolutionary government, is created.
dz: 创建了由五人组成的革命政府"法国目录".
de: The French Directory, a five-man revolutionary government, is created.

t: 斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基是独立波兰的最后一位国王,被迫退位并被流放到俄罗斯.
te: Stanisław August Poniatowski, the last king of independent Poland, is forced to abdicate and is exiled to Russia.
dz: 波兰分治:斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基是独立波兰的最后一位国王,被迫退位并被流放到俄罗斯.
de: Partitions of Poland: Stanisław August Poniatowski, the last king of independent Poland, is forced to abdicate and is exiled to Russia.

t: 永宜街的建设,原被公认为世界上最长的街道,开始于上加拿大的约克(今多伦多).
te: Construction of Yonge Street, formerly recognized as the longest street in the world, begins in York, Upper Canada (pre…
dz: 永宜街的建设,原被公认为世界上最长的街道,开始于上加拿大的约克(今多伦多).
de: Construction of Yonge Street, formerly recognized as the longest street in the world, begins in York, Upper Canada (present-day Toronto).
